lines.zh: 我的名字在我嘴边碎开了。
lines.en: My name breaks apart at my lips.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脚下响一声杂音。
lines.en: Every step makes a burst of static.

lines.zh: 走廊的墙像坏掉的画面。
lines.en: The corridor walls look like a broken picture.
I flicker twice per step.
The path repeats beneath me.
My shadow lags half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 我听见自己在倒着说话。
lines.en: I hear myself speaking backward.

lines.zh: 灯管跟我的步子一起闪。
lines.en: The lights flicker with my steps.
I took three steps and lost two.

lines.zh: 地面在我踩下去时错位。
lines.en: The floor misaligns when I step.

lines.zh: 那些声音是我自己的回声。
lines.en: Those sounds are my own echoes.
I walk slowly. I fear coming apart.
I stand, my body trembling.
Something is jumping on my face.
I said that twice.
I don't remember the last sentence.
The image on the wall has frozen.
I blinked, and it moved on.
I can hear my own static.

lines.zh: 这里的时间重复了一段。
lines.en: Time here repeated a stretch.
I'm back at the same motion.
I try to stop.
I can't.
And I repeated it.
I can't count how many times.
There's a burnt smell in the air.
While you look at me, I flicker.

lines.zh: 我的名字，只剩一串乱码。
lines.en: My name is nothing but garbled text now.
Can you see my face clearly?
It keeps changing.
I hear what you say twice.
The second time it's wrong.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我这边也坏了。
lines.en: Your shadow is broken on my side too.
I reach out, and my hand arrives elsewhere.
My left eye is slower than my right.
How long have you been standing there?
I think I asked that already.
I did ask.
Your outline has a double image.
I can't tell which one is you.
I count your fingers.
I counted six.

lines.zh: 这里的东西都会多出来一点。
lines.en: Things here always come out with extra.
Hold still. Let me sync first.
I fell a beat behind again.
There. You're still here.
Your damage trembles on me.
It counted twice.

lines.zh: 一次是真的，一次是影子。
lines.en: One real, one shadow.
This one didn't line up.
My voice cut out half a second.
You hit the previous frame.
I'm feeling it now.
The picture on the wall is all noise.
So am I.

lines.zh: 伤口里漏出的是雪花点。
lines.en: What leaks from the wound is static.
What you're holding is flashing.
I can't tell what it is.
It doubles in my eyes too.
I don't want to eat. I want to see it clearly.
Put it down and it will stop.
Its edges are shaking.
I reached out and grabbed twice.
Both missed.

lines.zh: 是不是我自己的手也没对上？
lines.en: Is my own hand out of sync too?
I gave up.
You hit me and I stuttered.
My motion repeated three times.

lines.zh: 你从我身体里穿过去一点。
lines.en: You passed slightly through me.
There's a gap on my side.
Don't touch that gap.
What's inside is still there.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起的声音很怪。
lines.en: The sound of us colliding is strange.
It echoed twice.
I stepped back, then reversed.
Now I'm where I started.
I can't remember if there was.

lines.zh: 这些话我重复了很多次。
lines.en: I've repeated these words many times.
Someone else's voice is in my mouth.
It may not sound like me to you.
I can't even hear myself clearly.
Don't come near this voice.
It learns how you speak.
And it doesn't give it back.
Half of mine has already been taken.
What's left is shaking.

lines.zh: 我捡的时候它跳了一下。
lines.en: When I picked it up, it jumped.
Now there are two in my hand.
I only touched it once.
This fell from your hand.
It doubles in my hand.
I put it down, and it's still there.
This thing won't sync.

lines.zh: 我把它推回原来的位置。
lines.en: I pushed it back where it was.

lines.zh: 丢掉的东西，又回到我手上。
lines.en: The thing I dropped is back in my hands.
I won't touch it again.
Your position shows in two places.
I can see you from either way.
One of them is moving.
I'll follow that one.
Not this one.
I ran the wrong way.
I'm back in this frame.
The corridor folded me once.
I hear you at the other end.
That sound is older than before.
I heard it earlier.
You weren't here then.
I only just arrived at it.
My time isn't the same as yours.
Walk on, and I'll follow.
You might see two of me.
I'm behind you and ahead.

lines.zh: 你回头时，那里只有噪点。
lines.en: When you turn, only static is there.

lines.zh: 我在你回头的那一帧里。
lines.en: I'm in the frame when you turn.
The corridor doesn't have enough resolution.
Each step, the picture fills a frame.
My movements are always a frame behind.
You can hear my feet dragging.
That sound repeats wrong.
I'll stop at seven.
One, two, four.
I skipped one.
The doors on the wall are skipping too.
Their order is scrambled.
I walked this path before.
The doors were in a different order then.
Follow the floor.
Don't follow the doors.
They'll send you back.
I don't know which time.
I only know it isn't this one.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，声音叠了两层。
lines.en: I hit you and the sound doubled.

lines.zh: 一层是现在，一层是上次。
lines.en: One is now, one is before.
Your wound doubled too.
I see two cuts.
Only one is bleeding.
I stepped back, then forward again.

lines.zh: 同一个动作我做了两遍。
lines.en: I did the same motion twice.
The second one missed.
My fist disappeared halfway.
It came back from the other side.
Don't think you dodged.
I'm still landing the last one.
You were pushed out of place.
Your shadow is half a beat late.
Now the two of you are apart.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，够到的是旧的那个。
lines.en: I reach, and I get the older one.
The picture broke first. Then I was here.
My name trembles on the screen.
Only a few strokes are left.
How many can you read?

lines.zh: 我感觉我本来不是这样。
lines.en: I feel I wasn't like this.
I can't recall the whole of me.

lines.zh: 走廊在我脚下重新加载。
lines.en: The corridor reloads under my feet.
I repeated a breath.
Another crack appeared on the wall.
It's the same as the earlier one.
I know I've been here already.
So have you, probably.

lines.zh: 我看见自己上一帧还站着。
lines.en: I see my last frame still standing.
It vanishes a moment after me.
I hear the sound of reloading.
This corridor is replaying.
I'll stop at the seventh.
I skipped one through six.
Only the two of us left in this place.
One of us isn't quite right.
Fire burns on me in two layers.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，又掉了一次。
lines.en: I fell, and then fell again.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，把画面灌坏了。
lines.en: Water poured in and ruined the picture.

lines.zh: 爆炸把走廊切成了几段。
lines.en: The blast cut the corridor into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，从另一边又出来了。
lines.en: The arrow went through and came out the other side.

lines.zh: 光扫过去，我的形状断了。
lines.en: Light swept past and my shape broke.

lines.zh: 我不确定我需不需要吃。
lines.en: I'm not sure I need to eat.
The lightning turned the whole frame white.
There's nothing in this frame.
